ensembles.name: Jazz Ensemble I
ensembles.description: The program’s flagship big band, and the group that carries our name at festivals and on record. It headlines both the fall and spring jazz festivals and anchors the annual album release.

photo.alt: Jazz Ensemble I group photo Spring 2026 Jazz Festival

ensembles.name: Jazz Ensemble II
ensembles.description: Our second big band, performing a full concert season of its own alongside the vocal ensembles. Many players move up through this group into Jazz Ensemble I.

photo.alt: Jazz Ensemble II on stage at Artemus W. Ham Hall Fall 2025 Jazz Festival

ensembles.name: Contemporary Jazz Ensemble
ensembles.description: Focused on modern and contemporary jazz writing, including music by our own composition students.

photo.alt: Contemporary Jazz Ensemble on stage at the Clark County Library Flamingo location Fall 2025

ensembles.name: Latin Jazz Ensemble
ensembles.description: Afro-Cuban, Brazilian and Latin jazz repertoire. The ensemble has recorded five albums in the Latin Journey series, and recorded along with the Joe Williams Scholarship Quintet in the most recent album Back Home.

photo.alt: Latin Jazz Ensemble on stage at the Clark County Library Flamingo location Spring 2026

ensembles.name: Studio Scarlet Jazz Vocal Ensemble
ensembles.description: A vocal jazz ensemble performing both on campus and in the community, appearing regularly on our Clark County Library series and the end-of-semester jazz festivals.

photo.alt: Studio Scarlet on stage at Artemus W. Ham Hall Fall 2025 Jazz Festival

ensembles.name: Maryland Parkway Jazz Vocal Ensemble
ensembles.description: A vocal jazz ensemble named for the street that runs alongside campus, sharing programs with our big bands and appearing on the annual Vocal Jazz Night.

photo.alt: Maryland Parkway on stage at Artemus W. Ham Hall Fall 2025 Jazz Festival

ensembles.name: Joe Williams Scholarship Combo
ensembles.description: A small group of scholarship students performing as a working jazz small group, on campus and throughout Las Vegas.

photo.alt: Joe Williams Scholarship Combo on stage at the Clark County Library Flamingo location Fall 2025

ensembles.name: Jazz Combos
ensembles.description: A number of sections of jazz combos (small group) are taught and directed every semester including in introduction to combo class for students who have never worked in a small group before. Students in all jazz combos work together to understand team work and leadership while also learning the lineage of the jazz combo and musical repertoire from the roots of jazz to today. Combos regularly perform at the end-of-semester jazz festivals.

photo.alt: One section of jazz combo in the Performing Arts Center lobby Fall 2025 jazz festival
